predecessors.text: the island and city of Rhodes, which surrendered to the knights on 15 August 1310

successors.name: Ottoman Empire
successors.text: Ottoman Rhodes (infobox 'Successor'); Rhodes and Kos 'came under direct Ottoman rule' after 1522 and the other islands 'were overrun within the year'

ledger.x: 15 August 1310: the Knights Hospitaller take Rhodes.
1402: the Knights build their mainland stronghold at Bodrum.
1522: the Order's islands pass to the Ottomans.
22 December 1522: Hospitaller Rhodes ends after 212 years.

wars.name: Hospitaller conquest of Rhodes
wars.outcome: After over four years of campaigning the city of Rhodes surrendered to the knights on 15 August 1310.

wars.name: Defeat of Andronikos III by the Knights of Rhodes
wars.outcome: 'In 1334, the Knights of Rhodes defeated Andronikos III Palaiologos and his Turkish auxiliaries.'

wars.name: Mamluk invasion of Rhodes
wars.outcome: The Knights withstood an invasion by Sultan Sayf ad-Din Jaqmaq in 1444.

wars.name: Siege of Rhodes (1480)
wars.outcome: Mehmed II's attack of 1480 'made the Knights a priority target'; the fortifications repelled it (Dodecanese page).

wars.name: Siege of Rhodes (1522)
wars.outcome: The siege began on 26 June 1522 and lasted six months; the city capitulated on 22 December and the knights marched out on 1 January 1523.
